_comment: Fire Totem (2026-07-21): the greater fire elemental's payload — a stationary totem that burns everything around it. Mechanically the SummonTotem pattern (spawn effect, skill level scales TTL + the totem's loadout level, owner level adds HP/power), but the totem's aura hits ALL enemies in range rather than the nearest one: SummonTotem is a single-target poke, FireTotem is area denial. cooldownTicks 450 ≥ the max-level TTL (420) keeps it one-totem-at-a-time by content convention (§8.3, no cap system).
